title: Spieljoch Adventure Mountain Fügen
name: Spieljoch Adventure Mountain Fügen
kurzbeschreibung: The Erlebnisalm Spieljoch in Fügen in the Zillertal: 10-seater gondola to 1,865 m featuring a water play park, flying fox, barefoot trail, and show mine.
beschreibung:
Overview

The versatile Erlebnisalm Spieljoch sits at an elevation of 1,865 meters as the first panoramic adventure mountain at the entrance to the Zillertal in the municipality of Fügen (Schwaz district). Aboard the state-of-the-art 10-passenger gondola Spieljochbahn, visitors ascend more than 1,300 meters in elevation from the valley floor in just a few minutes into the high-alpine arena of the Tuxer Voralpen. Featuring a vast water and adventure area right at the mountain station, the Spieljochbahn ranks among Tyrol's leading summer family destinations.

Water Adventure Park, Show Mine & Flying Fox

At the mountain station, visitors discover an expansive, naturally designed water adventure playground: children dam mountain streams, navigate wooden rafts across the shallow reservoir pond, operate Archimedes water screws, and balance on slacklines and climbing walls. Thrill-seekers zoom across the lake on the spectacular Flying Fox zipwire or test their skills in the airy high-ropes course. A special sensory treat is the roughly one-kilometer-long barefoot walking trail leading up to the summit cross of the Spieljoch (1,920 m): traversing gravel, tree bark, moss, and wooden planks, hikers experience alpine nature firsthand. Just a few minutes' walk below the mountain station lies the historic Schaubergwerk Öxltal – Austria's highest exhibition mine – where guests delve into centuries of Zillertal iron and copper mining tradition.

Visit & Getting There

The Spieljochbahn operates daily throughout the summer season from late May to late October from 08:30 to 16:30. Admission to the water play park and barefoot path is included free of charge with the cable car ticket. Cable car fares (as of the 2025/2026 season): round trip adults approx. €29.50, children (born 2010–2018) approx. €15.00. Holders of the Zillertal Activcard enjoy one free round trip per day. Getting there by car: Via the B169 into the Zillertal as far as Fügen, follow signs to the valley station at Hochfügener Straße 77 (large free parking lot). By public transport: Zillertalbahn train to Fügen-Hart station, from where the free local shuttle bus runs directly to the valley station.

Tips

The gondola and the plateau at the mountain station, including the mountain restaurant Mountain Loft, are step-free and fully accessible for strollers and wheelchairs. The Mountain Loft boasts an expansive sun terrace with lounge furniture and top-notch wood-fired pizza.
